title: Hamas agrees to disarmament roadmap under Gaza ceasefire deal
subhead: The Palestinian militant group said it had accepted a US-backed plan under which its weapons would be transferred to a new Palestinian governing body as Israeli forces withdraw in phases, though Israel has yet to endorse the agreement and insists any pullback depends on Hamas's complete disarmament.

title: Pakistan's Broad Peak: Challenging search for 10 buried climbers, including Nirmal Purja
subhead: Ten people were caught in an avalanche Thursday in the Karakoram range, including the renowned Nepalese climber known for summiting all 14 of the world's highest peaks in record time. Four bodies were located, and the search is set to continue Saturday.
